implement_Future_cancel: implement a concrete Future subclass that cancels an in-flight computation and returns a boolean
implement_Future_result: implement a concrete Future subclass that returns the computation result or raises TimeoutError or CancelledError
implement_Future_add_done_callback: implement a concrete Future subclass that registers a callback function to invoke when the computation completes
implement_Future_traceback: implement a concrete Future subclass that returns the traceback object of an exception raised by the computation
raise_CancelledError_or_TimeoutError: raise a CancelledError or TimeoutError exception when a Future computation is cancelled or exceeds its timeout
